one_liner.value: Gorgias offers a REST API secured via Basic Auth and an OAuth2 flow for public apps.
one_liner.quote: The Gorgias REST API lets you read and write data... To authenticate API requests, Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication...

gating_notes.value: OAuth2 requires a partner app approval; Basic Auth needs admin credentials from an existing Gorgias account.
gating_notes.quote: In order to be able to have an approved public app with Gorgias, it is required that the app is using OAuth2 for authentication. ... The account owner and admins can access the API credentials and create API keys

oauth_details.value: Create an app in the partner account, obtain client_id and client_secret, redirect user to https://{subdomain}.gorgias.com/oauth/authorize, exchange code for a 24‑hour access token, use refresh token for new tokens.
oauth_details.quote: Creating an app on the partners’ account... Obtaining the client_id and client_secret... Authorization redirection... Post request to obtain the access token (has a 24 hours expiration time)
